originalTitle: China advises its citizens to leave Taiwan ally Eswatini over 'security risks'
title: Big News! People Are Asked to Leave Eswatini!
content:
Hello, News Explorers!

Hey everyone! It's your friendly news pal from Africa, ready to share some important stories with you! We're like little detectives, looking for news and learning about our amazing continent and the world. Today, we have some interesting news from a special country in Africa called Eswatini. It's a small but beautiful place, full of wonderful people and nature. So, let's put on our explorer hats and learn together!

What's the Big News Today?

There's a very big country far away called China. China has lots and lots of people. Some of these people from China live and work in Eswatini, our African neighbour. Now, China has told its people living in Eswatini something important. They have said, "Please go back home for a little while." It's like when your parents tell you to come inside because it might rain soon. They want to make sure everyone is safe.

Who is Eswatini?

Eswatini is a lovely country in Southern Africa. It used to be called Swaziland. It's a small country, but it's very important! It has beautiful mountains, rivers, and lots of lovely animals. People there are very friendly. Did you know? Eswatini is one of the smallest countries in Africa! But it has a big heart and wonderful traditions. Many people in Eswatini farm, which means they grow food from the earth. They also make beautiful crafts. It's a kingdom, which means it has a King who leads the country.

Who is China?

China is a very, very big country! It's super far away from Africa, on another part of the world map. China has more people than any other country in the whole world! Imagine how many friends you could make there! Did you know? China is famous for its Great Wall, which is a super long wall built a very, very long time ago! It's so long you can see it from space! People from China live and work all over the world, including in our beloved Africa. They help build roads, schools, and even bring new toys and clothes to different places.

Why Are People Leaving?

So, why did China ask its people to go home from Eswatini? China said there might be "security risks." Now, that's a big word, but let's make it simple. "Security risks" means that things might not be very safe or steady for a little while. It's like when the weather forecast says there might be a big storm. Your parents tell you to stay indoors to be safe. It doesn't mean anything scary is happening right now, but it's like a warning to be extra careful. China just wants to make sure its people are okay and away from any possible trouble. Did you know? Countries always try their best to keep their own people safe, no matter where they are in the world. It's like how your family looks out for you!

Eswatini's Special Friend: Taiwan!

Now, here's where it gets really interesting! Eswatini has a special friend country. This friend is called Taiwan. Taiwan is an island, which means it's land surrounded by water, very far away. Did you know? Countries can choose their friends, just like you choose your friends at school! And Eswatini chose Taiwan to be a special friend. Taiwan is also a country with lots of people, but it's not as big as China. China and Taiwan have a very long and sometimes tricky history. They don't always agree on everything.

What Does "Being Friends" Mean for Countries?

When countries are friends, it's called having "diplomatic relations." That's another big word, but it just means they talk to each other a lot, they help each other, and they have special agreements. Imagine you and your best friend always talk, play together, and help each other with homework. That's what countries do when they have diplomatic relations. They send special people, like messengers, to live in each other's countries to keep the friendship strong. Eswatini and Taiwan have this kind of special friendship. They help each other with things like farming, building, and learning. It's a very important bond for both of them.

Eswatini is Super Special!

Guess what makes Eswatini even more special in this story? Eswatini is the ONLY country in the whole of Africa that has this special friendship, or "diplomatic relations," with Taiwan! Isn't that amazing? Did you know? There are only 12 countries in the world that have this special friendship with Taiwan, and Eswatini is one of them, and the only one in Africa! That makes Eswatini unique! Because of this special friendship, sometimes big countries like China, who don't agree with Taiwan, might feel a bit worried. It's like when your friends have different opinions on a game.

What Happens Now?

So, China asked its people to leave Eswatini for a little while, just to be safe. This doesn't mean that Eswatini is a bad place or that anything terrible is definitely going to happen. It's just a careful step that China is taking to look after its own people. We hope that everyone stays safe and that things become steady and calm again very soon in Eswatini. Life in Eswatini will continue, and the friendly people there will keep going about their daily lives. We will keep watching the news to see what happens next.

Let's Remember to Be Kind!

It's important to remember that all countries and all people want to be safe and happy. Sometimes, countries don't agree, but it's important to always be kind and try to understand each other. We love Eswatini and all our African neighbours! We hope for peace and safety for everyone. That's all for today from your friendly African news pal! See you next time!
summary: China has told its people to leave Eswatini, an African country, because of worries about safety, and Eswatini is special because it's the only African friend of Taiwan.
whyMatters: This news is important because it shows how countries talk to each other and look after their people, especially when one country (Eswatini) has a special friendship with another (Taiwan) that a very big country (China) does not agree with.

originalTitle: Guinea's president dismisses 173 soldiers, including coup ally, for desertion
title: Big Boss in Guinea Makes Changes for His Country
content:
Hello from Guinea!

Hi friends! I'm your special news reporter, bringing you exciting news from our amazing continent, Africa! Today, we're flying over to a beautiful country called Guinea. Can you say Guinea? It's a country in West Africa, known for its green hills and big rivers. It has lots of friendly people and cool animals!

Who is the Big Boss in Guinea?

Every country has a leader, right? Like your school has a principal. In Guinea, the leader is called the President. His name is President Mamady Doumbouya. He is like the head teacher of the whole country! He helps make sure everything runs smoothly for all the people living in Guinea. He has a very important job, trying to keep everyone safe and happy. Sometimes, leaders come to power in different ways. President Doumbouya became president a little while ago, and now he is working hard to lead the country.

What Happened This Week?

Something big happened this week in Guinea! The President made a very important decision. He said "goodbye" to many soldiers. A soldier is a person who works to protect their country and its people. They wear uniforms and train to be strong and brave. President Doumbouya told 173 soldiers that they could not be soldiers anymore. That's a lot of people, isn't it? Imagine 173 friends in your class! It's a big number. **Did you know?** The capital city of Guinea is Conakry! It's a busy city right by the ocean.

Why Did Some Soldiers Leave?

These soldiers were told to leave because of something called "desertion." Desertion means that a soldier leaves their important job without asking for permission. Imagine if you had a very important job, like guarding a gate, and you just left without telling anyone. That wouldn't be very good, right? Soldiers have a serious job to do. They need to be there to protect everyone. So, when some soldiers didn't follow the rules and left their posts, the President had to make a decision. It's like when you have rules in school, and if someone doesn't follow them, there are consequences.

Why is This Important for the President?

The President is working very hard to make sure he is strong and clear about his leadership. He wants everyone to know that he is in charge and that rules must be followed. This is called "consolidating control." It means making sure that his power is firm and that everyone understands he is the leader. He wants to bring peace and order to Guinea. When a leader is strong and fair, it helps the whole country be strong and fair too. He wants to make sure all the soldiers are working together and doing their jobs properly. **Did you know?** Guinea is sometimes called "The Water Tower of West Africa" because many big rivers start there!

What is a Soldier's Job?

Soldiers are very important people. They help keep the country safe from danger. They protect the borders and help people in emergencies. They train very hard to be strong and disciplined. They learn how to follow orders and work as a team. Imagine a team of superheroes, but their job is to protect a whole country! It's a serious responsibility, and they need to be ready always. That's why following rules and being present for duty is so important for them.

What About "Coup Allies"?

The news also talked about a "coup ally." This might sound like a big word! A "coup" happens when a group of soldiers takes over the government suddenly, instead of waiting for people to vote for new leaders. It's like changing the school principal in the middle of the night without anyone knowing! It can make things a bit confusing and sometimes scary for people. An "ally" is like a friend or a helper. So, a "coup ally" means someone who helped with that sudden change a while ago. The President is now making sure that everyone working with him is doing things the right way, following the current rules. **Did you know?** Guinea has very rich soil and lots of natural resources, like minerals.

Why Are Rules Important for Everyone?

Imagine if there were no rules in your home or your school. Everyone would do whatever they wanted, and it might get messy or unfair! Rules help us know what to do and what not to do. They help everyone stay safe and happy. When soldiers follow rules, it helps the whole country stay safe and peaceful. When a leader, like President Doumbouya, makes sure rules are followed, it helps build a strong and fair country for all the children and families in Guinea. He wants his country to be a place where everyone can live well.

What Happens Next for Guinea?

Now that the President has made these decisions, he hopes that everyone will work together for a better future. He wants to make sure that all the soldiers are doing their jobs properly and helping to keep the peace. This helps everyone in Guinea to feel safe and to work towards building a wonderful country. We hope for peace and happiness for all the children in Guinea! The President is trying to make sure that his country is stable and strong. **Did you know?** The national animal of Guinea is the lion, a symbol of strength and courage!

More Fun Facts About Guinea!

Guinea is a fascinating place! People there speak a language called French, but they also speak many other local languages. They have yummy food, great music, and vibrant cultures. It's a land of incredible beauty with diverse landscapes, from coastal plains to highland plateaus. The people of Guinea are known for their warmth and hospitality. They are always working hard to make their country a better place. Knowing about different countries in Africa helps us understand our big continent better!
summary: The President of Guinea said goodbye to 173 soldiers who left their important jobs, because he wants to make sure his country is strong and everyone follows the rules.
whyMatters: This is important because when leaders make sure rules are followed, it helps to keep a country peaceful and safe for everyone, especially the children.

originalTitle: Meta agrees to settlement, platform changes in youth addiction case
title: Apps Get Safer for Kids! Big News for Facebook and Instagram!
content:
Hello, Super Star Listeners!

Hi everyone! It's your kid-friendly news reporter for Africa, ready to share some really big and exciting news with you! Are you ready for a story about your favourite apps? Today, we're talking about something very important for all children and young people who use apps like Facebook and Instagram. These are apps that many grown-ups and some older kids use on their phones and computers.

What's This Big News About?

There's a really big company called Meta. Meta is the company that helps make the apps Facebook and Instagram. Maybe your older brother or sister, or your parents, use these apps to share photos and talk to friends. Well, Meta has made a very important promise! They have agreed to make some big changes to how Facebook and Instagram work. These changes are all about making sure that young people, like you, use the apps in a way that is good for you and keeps you safe and happy. Did you know? Meta is one of the biggest technology companies in the whole world! They want their apps to be fun for everyone, but also safe.

Why Were People Worried?

Sometimes, using apps too much can be a problem. Have you ever played a game or watched cartoons for so long that your eyes felt tired, or you missed playing outside? Some young people were spending _too_ much time on Facebook and Instagram. It was hard for them to stop, even when they knew they should. This is sometimes called spending too much time or even feeling like you can't stop. When you spend too much time on screens, it can make you feel tired or even a little sad. It can stop you from playing your favourite games outside or reading a good book. Did you know? Playing outside is super important! It helps your body grow strong, and your mind stays happy. You can run, jump, play football, or even just look at the clouds!

What is a "Lawsuit"?

Now, how did this big change happen? Some people, like parents and doctors, were very worried about young people using the apps too much. So, they decided to have a big discussion in a special place called a court. This is like a very big, serious argument, but with rules and a judge. When people have this kind of big argument in court, it's called a "lawsuit." It means they want to talk about a problem and find a way to fix it. They wanted Meta to make their apps better for kids. Did you know? In many parts of Africa, people love to tell stories and talk to each other face-to-face. It’s a wonderful way to connect and share ideas!

What Does "Settlement" Mean?

After a long time, Meta decided to stop the big argument. They said, "We hear you! We want to make things better." When they agree to stop the argument and promise to fix things, it's called a "settlement." Meta also agreed to pay a very, very, very lot of money. This money helps fix some of the problems from before. But the most important part of the settlement is that Meta is going to make their apps different so they are much safer for young people in the future. Did you know? Saying sorry and promising to make things right is a very important part of being a good friend and neighbour! Just like in our communities, it's good when big companies listen and make positive changes.

Exciting Changes Are Coming!

So, what kinds of changes will Meta make to Facebook and Instagram? They are going to add new things that will help young people take breaks. Maybe the app will gently remind you to stop and go play outside, or read a book. They will also give parents more tools. This means parents can help their children manage their screen time better. It’s like having a helpful guide to make sure you’re not spending too much time looking at a screen when you could be having other adventures! These changes will make the apps less "sticky," meaning they won't try so hard to keep you online for a very long time. They want you to enjoy the apps but also remember to live your real-world life. Did you know? Our brains are like super computers, and they need breaks too! Taking a break from screens helps your brain rest and get ready for new learning and fun.

Why This is Great News for YOU!

This is wonderful news for all young people! It means that using apps can be safer and more balanced. You can still see fun pictures or talk to friends, but it will be easier to remember to stop and do other exciting things. Less screen time means more time for playing games, running around, helping your family, reading amazing stories, or even learning a new skill. It means more time for your eyes to rest, and more time for your body to move and grow strong. Did you know? Africa has so many amazing traditional games that don't need any screens! Like _Ampe_ from Ghana, _mancala_ games like _Kalaha_ or _Bao_, or just playing hide-and-seek with your friends!

What You Can Do!

Even with these new changes, it’s always good to remember a few things. Talk to your parents or older family members about how much time you spend on screens. They can help you make a plan for balancing your screen time with other fun activities. Remember to play outside every day, even if it's just for a little while. Read books, draw pictures, help with chores, and spend time with your family and friends. These things make you happy and healthy! Did you know? Getting enough sleep every night helps your body and brain grow bigger and stronger. It's like charging your own batteries!

Let's All Play Safely!

So, this is truly a happy day for children and young people everywhere. Meta is listening and making their apps better and safer for you. It's all about making sure technology helps you learn and connect, but also leaves plenty of time for you to explore the wonderful world around you. Keep shining brightly, my super star listeners! And remember to have fun in all the ways possible – both on and off the screen! Did you know? You are special and have so many amazing things to discover in the real world, right here in Africa and beyond! Go explore!
summary: Meta, the company behind Facebook and Instagram, has promised to make big changes to its apps to help young people use them safely and not spend too much time on them.
whyMatters: This is important because it means big apps like Facebook and Instagram will be safer for children and help them remember to play outside and do other fun things instead of just looking at screens all the time.
